lec06-sockets-pipes-3.title: 父子进程各自持有 descriptor 引用
lec06-sockets-pipes-3.source:
flowchart TD
P["Parent：fd 0 / 1 / 2"] --> T["同一个 terminal"]
C["Child：fd 0 / 1 / 2"] --> T
C -. "Child close(0)" .-> C2["Child：移除 fd 0，保留 fd 1 / 2"]
P -. "不受 Child close 影响" .-> P2["Parent：fd 0 仍然有效"]
lec06-sockets-pipes-3.description:
Parent: fd 0 / 1 / 2 ──→ terminal
Child : fd 0 / 1 / 2 ──→ 同一个 terminal

Child close(0) 后：
Parent: fd 0 仍可输入
Child : fd 0 的引用已移除，fd 1 / 2 仍可输出

lec06-sockets-pipes-5.title: Queue 暂存尚未消费的数据
lec06-sockets-pipes-5.source:
flowchart TD
n0["Producer memory"]
n1["write"]
n2["Queue：暂存数据"]
n3["read"]
n4["Consumer memory"]
n0 --> n1 --> n2 --> n3 --> n4
lec06-sockets-pipes-5.description:
Producer memory → write → queue → read → Consumer memory
                          ↑
                    暂存尚未消费的数据

lec06-sockets-pipes-6.title: Socket 是连接两端的通信端点
lec06-sockets-pipes-6.source:
flowchart LR
subgraph C[Client process]
CS[Client socket]
end
subgraph S[Server process]
SS[Connected socket]
end
CS <-->|TCP connection| SS

      │                                                  │

lec06-sockets-pipes-7.title: TCP 的两个方向分别传输
lec06-sockets-pipes-7.source:
flowchart TD
CW[Client write] --> CB[Client send buffer] --> N1[Network] --> SR[Server receive buffer] --> SREAD[Server read]
SW[Server write] --> SB[Server send buffer] --> N2[Network] --> CR[Client receive buffer] --> CREAD[Client read]
lec06-sockets-pipes-7.description:
Client write → Client send buffer → network → Server receive buffer → Server read
Client read  ← Client receive buffer ← network ← Server send buffer ← Server write

lec06-sockets-pipes-8.title: 阻塞 read：等待期间 CPU 运行其他工作
lec06-sockets-pipes-8.source:
flowchart TD
A[调用 read] --> B[线程进入等待]
B --> C[CPU 可以运行其他线程]
B -->|数据到达或出现 EOF / error| D[线程重新具备运行条件]
D -->|被调度运行| E[read 返回]
lec06-sockets-pipes-8.description:
调用 read → 进入等待 → CPU 可以运行其他线程
                       ↓ 数据到达或出现 EOF / error
                 线程可被调度运行 → read 返回

lec06-sockets-pipes-11.title: 字节流通过分隔符划分消息
lec06-sockets-pipes-11.source:

h e l l o \0 n e x t \0
└─ message 1 ─┘ └─ message 2 ─┘

lec06-sockets-pipes-16.title: Listener 接收连接，conn_fd 负责通信
lec06-sockets-pipes-16.source:
flowchart TD
L["listen_fd：长期保留"] -->|accept| A["conn_fd_A：与 Client A 读写"]
L -->|accept| B["conn_fd_B：与 Client B 读写"]

     ├─ accept → conn_fd_A：与 Client A 读写
     └─ accept → conn_fd_B：与 Client B 读写

lec06-sockets-pipes-21.title: Short write：从尚未发送的位置继续
lec06-sockets-pipes-21.source:
flowchart TD
n0["len = 10，sent = 0"]
n1["第一次 write 返回 4"]
n2["sent = 4，剩 6 bytes，从 buf + 4 继续"]
n3["第二次 write 返回 6"]
n4["sent = 10，完成"]
n0 --> n1 --> n2 --> n3 --> n4
lec06-sockets-pipes-21.description:
总长度 len = 10
第一次 write 返回 4 → 还剩 6，从 buf + 4 继续
第二次 write 返回 6 → sent = 10，完成

lec06-sockets-pipes-23.title: 串行服务：A 结束后才接收 B
lec06-sockets-pipes-23.source:
flowchart TD
n0["accept A"]
n1["serve A"]
n2["close A"]
n3["accept B"]
n4["serve B"]
n5["close B"]
n0 --> n1 --> n2 --> n3 --> n4 --> n5
lec06-sockets-pipes-23.description: accept A → serve A → close A → accept B → serve B → close B

lec06-sockets-pipes-24.title: Fork 之后，父子承担不同工作
lec06-sockets-pipes-24.source:
flowchart TD
A[Parent accept] --> F[fork]
F --> P[Parent：管理 listener，继续接收]
F --> C[Child：处理刚接收的 conn_fd]
lec06-sockets-pipes-24.description:
Parent：accept → fork → 管理 listener
Child ：只处理刚接收的 conn_fd

lec06-sockets-pipes-26.title: 立即 wait 会阻塞接收循环
lec06-sockets-pipes-26.source:
sequenceDiagram
participant P as Parent
participant A as Child A
Note over P: accept A
P->>A: fork A
Note over P: wait A，暂停接收
Note over A: serve A
A-->>P: exit，wait 返回
Note over P: accept B
lec06-sockets-pipes-26.description:
Parent：accept A → fork A → wait A ─────────→ accept B
Child A：                  serve A → exit

lec06-sockets-pipes-27.title: 并发服务：接收循环不等待当前连接结束
lec06-sockets-pipes-27.source:
sequenceDiagram
participant P as Parent
participant A as Child A
participant B as Child B
Note over P: accept A
P->>A: fork A
activate A
Note over P: accept B
P->>B: fork B
activate B
Note over P: accept C ...
Note over A: serve A
Note over B: serve B
A-->>P: exit
 deactivate A
B-->>P: exit
 deactivate B
lec06-sockets-pipes-27.description:
Parent ：accept A → fork A → accept B → fork B → accept C ...
Child A：          serve A ─────────────────────→ exit
Child B：                              serve B ───────→ exit

lec06-sockets-pipes-28.title: 主线程接收，worker 处理连接
lec06-sockets-pipes-28.source:
sequenceDiagram
participant M as Main thread
participant W as Worker
Note over M: accept
M->>W: pthread_create，交付连接
Note over M: 继续 accept
Note over W: read → process → write
Note over W: close → return
lec06-sockets-pipes-28.description:
Main thread：accept → pthread_create → accept → ...
Worker     ：        read → process → write → close → return

lec06-sockets-pipes-29.title: 错误关闭：线程共享 descriptor table
lec06-sockets-pipes-29.source:
flowchart TD
n0["Main 把 conn_fd 交给 Worker"]
n1["Main 立即 close(conn_fd)"]
n2["Worker 再 read(conn_fd)"]
n3["该 fd 已关闭，编号甚至可能被复用"]
n0 --> n1 --> n2 --> n3
lec06-sockets-pipes-29.description:
错误做法：
Main 把 conn_fd 交给 Worker
Main 立即 close(conn_fd)
Worker 再 read(conn_fd) → fd 已关闭，甚至可能被复用

lec06-sockets-pipes-31.title: 线程池：队列把请求分配给固定 workers
lec06-sockets-pipes-31.source:

Q --> W2[Worker 2]
Q --> W3[Worker 3]
Q --> W4[Worker 4]
lec06-sockets-pipes-31.description:
accept → task queue → Worker 1
                   → Worker 2
                   → Worker 3
                   → Worker 4

lec06-sockets-pipes-33.title: Pipe：写端进入，读端取出
lec06-sockets-pipes-33.source:
flowchart TD

n1["Kernel pipe buffer"]
n2["read：pipe_fd[0]，read end"]
n0 --> n1 --> n2
lec06-sockets-pipes-33.description:
write(pipe_fd[1], ...) → kernel pipe buffer → read(pipe_fd[0], ...)
        write end                                  read end

lec06-sockets-pipes-35.title: Pipe 传递数据，不传递私有指针
lec06-sockets-pipes-35.source:
flowchart TD
n0["Parent 用户内存：msg"]
n1["write 复制数据到内核"]
n2["Kernel pipe buffer"]
n3["read 复制数据到用户内存"]
n4["Child 用户内存：buf"]
n0 --> n1 --> n2 --> n3 --> n4
lec06-sockets-pipes-35.description:
Parent 用户内存里的 msg
    → write → 内核 pipe buffer
    → read  → Child 用户内存里的 buf

lec06-sockets-pipes-38.title: 先完成写入并关闭写端，再等待 child
lec06-sockets-pipes-38.source:
flowchart TD
subgraph BAD[错误：形成相互等待]
W[Parent wait Child] --> R[Child 等待空 pipe 的数据]
R --> W
end
subgraph GOOD[正确：让数据和 EOF 先到达]
A[Parent write] --> B[Parent close 写端] --> C[Parent wait Child]
A --> D[Child read]
B --> E[所有写端关闭，剩余数据读尽]
D --> E --> F[Child read 得到 EOF] --> G[Child exit]
G --> H[Parent wait 返回]
C --> H
end
lec06-sockets-pipes-38.description:
错误顺序：Parent wait Child → Child read 空 pipe → 双方等待
正确顺序：Parent write → close 写端 → wait Child
                           Child read → EOF → exit

lec06-sockets-pipes-40.title: User stack 与 kernel stack
lec06-sockets-pipes-40.source:
flowchart TD
n0["用户函数执行：使用 user stack"]
n1["调用 read 等系统调用：进入内核"]
n2["内核处理：使用对应 kernel stack"]
n3["系统调用完成或恢复后返回用户代码"]
n0 --> n1 --> n2 --> n3
lec06-sockets-pipes-40.description:
用户代码执行函数 → 使用 user stack
调用 read 等系统调用 → 进入内核，使用对应 kernel stack
完成或恢复系统调用 → 回到用户代码

  wait returns ◄─────────────── termination collected

栈顶 → B 的 frame：B 的局部状态，返回 A 的位置
       A 的 frame：A 的局部状态，返回 main 的位置
       main 的 frame

P["局部变量 p：保存地址，生命周期较短"] --> H["分配的 int：42，直到 free 才释放"]

lec06-sockets-pipes-extra-48.title: 本讲主线：从隔离到通信
lec06-sockets-pipes-extra-48.source:
flowchart TD
n0["独立 address spaces"]
n1["需要 IPC：普通私有变量不能直接通知另一个进程"]
n2["Read / write 传输字节"]
n3["Socket：寻址、连接、双向通信"]
n4["Process / thread / pool：安排谁处理连接"]
n5["本机父子进程可用 Pipe：简单单向通道"]
n0 --> n1 --> n2 --> n3 --> n4 --> n5
lec06-sockets-pipes-extra-48.description:
独立 address spaces
    ↓ 不能靠修改自己的普通变量通知对方
需要 IPC
    ↓ 用 read / write 传输字节
Socket：解决寻址、连接、双向通信
    ↓ 同时来了很多客户端
Process / thread / thread pool：安排谁处理连接
    ↓ 如果只是本机父子进程通信
Pipe：建立简单的单向通道

lec06-sockets-pipes-extra-49.title: 从 fd 索引到打开的文件
lec06-sockets-pipes-extra-49.source:
flowchart TD
n0["程序中的整数：fd = 3"]
n1["以 fd 为索引，查内核中的本进程 descriptor table"]
n2["表项引用内核 open file description"]
n3["找到文件及其数据"]
n0 --> n1 --> n2 --> n3
lec06-sockets-pipes-extra-49.description:
程序里的整数 fd = 3
       ↓ 作为索引
该进程的 file descriptor table（内核中）
       ↓ 表项引用
open file description（内核中）
       ↓
文件及其数据

lec06-sockets-pipes-extra-50.title: 不同 I/O 对象，共同的操作接口
lec06-sockets-pipes-extra-50.source:
flowchart TD
n0["Regular file / terminal / socket / pipe"]
n1["File descriptor"]
n2["Read / write / close"]
n0 --> n1 --> n2
lec06-sockets-pipes-extra-50.description:
Regular file / terminal / socket / pipe
                    ↓
       file descriptor + read/write/close

lec05-files-extra-51.title: Open 返回的是本进程的 descriptor
lec05-files-extra-51.source:
flowchart TD
n0["open input.txt，以 O_RDONLY 打开"]
n1["成功返回 3，程序保存 fd = 3"]
n2["read 的第一个参数传 3"]
n3["内核查找本进程编号 3 对应的打开文件"]
n0 --> n1 --> n2 --> n3
lec05-files-extra-51.description:
open("input.txt", O_RDONLY) 返回 3
                  ↓
程序保存 fd = 3
                  ↓
以后 read(3, ...) 就是在请求：读取本进程编号 3 对应的打开文件

lec04-process-extra-52.title: Exec 替换程序，保留进程身份
lec04-process-extra-52.source:
flowchart TD
n0["Exec 前：Child，PID 101，原 C 程序"]
n1["execv 成功，旧程序映像被替换"]
n2["Exec 后：仍为 PID 101，开始执行 echo"]
n0 --> n1 --> n2
lec04-process-extra-52.description:
Exec 前：Child，PID 101，执行原来的 C 程序
                         ↓ execv 成功
Exec 后：仍是 PID 101，开始执行 echo 程序

lec03-thread-process-extra-53.title: 应用通过库与受控接口使用内核服务
lec03-thread-process-extra-53.source:
flowchart TD
n0["Application code"]
n1["普通函数调用：libraries / runtime，通常处于 user mode"]
n2["需要系统服务时：controlled system call"]
n3["Kernel：保护、调度、资源管理"]
n4["Hardware"]
n0 --> n1 --> n2 --> n3 --> n4
lec03-thread-process-extra-53.description:
Application code
  ↓ ordinary calls
Libraries / runtime (mostly user mode)
  ↓ controlled system calls when needed
Kernel: protection, scheduling, resource management
  ↓ manages
Hardware
